description: Four units whose extension substream is 72 bytes long, less than its header and the sizes of its assets' components add up to, written in 16-bit words, little endian.

skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's decoder sets the profile itself when it has decoded a frame (dca_core.c, dca_xll.c), and DTS-HD Master Audio or DTS-HD High Resolution Audio only after it has decoded the extension, which the stub components do not allow
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the assets' sizes that add up to more than the substream (dca_exss.c: 'EXSS asset out of bounds')
